The '''Glom Tho system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hevvrol sector/Legends|Hevvrol sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glom Tho]].
